As the primary escalation point during rostered shifts, you will be responsible for managing escalated incidents, fault prioritisation, contractual response compliance, jeopardy management and operational decision making. Monitor fault prioritisation, classification and jeopardy management activities to ensure contractual response and restoration timeframes are met. Review alarm handling, fault records and incident logs to ensure accuracy, quality and compliance. Monitor SLA and KPI performance, identify risks and support continuous improvement initiatives. Provide coaching, mentoring and operational support to Alarm Monitoring Officers. Prepare operational reports and support contract compliance, audit and performance reporting activities. About You Experience working in a control room, operations centre or alarm monitoring environment. Previous experience leading or supervising teams within a shift-based operational setting. Strong incident management experience, including coordination of high-priority or complex operational events. Ability to make sound decisions under pressure and effectively manage competing priorities. Strong analytical, problem-solving and critical thinking skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage a broad range of stakeholders. Experience with SCATS, STREAMS, Network Management Systems, Maximo, MMIS or similar operational platforms is highly regarded. Understanding of KPI, SLA and contractual performance requirements. Commitment to safety, continuous improvement and operational excellence. Availability to work a 24/7 rotating roster including days, afternoons, nights, weekends and public holidays. Mentor engineers across teams through technical reviews, thoughtful feedback, knowledge sharing, and hands-on guidance. Strong experience with both relational and NoSQL data models, particularly for complex transactional workloads, along with familiarity with streaming and analytical data stores. Strong understanding of production reliability, monitoring, SLOs, performance optimization, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis. Experience with abuse prevention, fraud detection, velocity controls, adversarial defense systems, or other trust and safety technologies is strongly preferred. Familiarity with hallucination mitigation approaches for AI-enabled systems, including code constraints, testing frameworks, embeddings, and context injection. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with sound judgment when balancing technical risk, customer impact, and business requirements. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to engineering and non-technical stakeholders. A pragmatic, hands-on approach, combining long-term architectural thinking with iterative delivery and measurable outcomes. A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline is beneficial but equivalent professional experience may be considered. Contributions to open-source projects, internal engineering platforms, or technical publications are a plus. Benefits Fully remote work environment within India. Opportunity to work on mission-critical backend infrastructure operating at significant scale. High degree of technical ownership and influence over architecture and engineering standards.
